optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Pipeline Engineer, Developer Tools Platform

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained build-event ingestion pipelines and schemas, ensuring backward compatibility through schema versioning.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the build-event ingestion pipelines (Kafka consumers writing to the events warehouse) and their schemas, adding schema versioning so that older event formats kept loading after producer changes.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into per-repository tables behind engineering dashboards.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the daily aggregate jobs that roll build, test and deployment events into the per-repository tables behind the engineering dashboards.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated schema and job changes with dashboard and platform teams, recording responsibility boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated schema and job changes with the dashboard team and the platform team in the weekly data sync; the platform lead approved warehouse changes and the dashboard team confirmed the table contracts.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented lineage, known limitations, and hand-over conditions for each pipeline release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, listing source topics, the incremental logic, the known limitation that late events beyond 48 hours were not re-aggregated, and the hand-over items for on-call.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Pipeline monitoring dashboard export showing daily completion time for sixty days, baseline line, and release marker, with job run identifiers as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the pipeline monitoring dashboard export (daily completion time for sixty days, baseline line, release marker) and the lineage note for the aggregate jobs, with the job run identifiers as a verification trail.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s experience in maintaining build-event ingestion pipelines, daily aggregate jobs, reducing aggregate completion time, coordinating with dashboard and platform teams, and documenting lineage and hand-over conditions.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Data Pipeline Engineer role.
